text:
**1. Can you use a Claude (Pro/web) subscription with Hermes?**
**No.** Hermes Agent cannot use consumer Claude Pro/Team web subscriptions. To use Claude models with Hermes, you need a standard Anthropic API key from the [Anthropic Console](https://console.anthropic.com/) (pay-as-you-go token billing).

**2. Does Hermes use the official harness under the hood?**
**No.** Hermes Agent is its own standalone open-source agentic harness and execution loop. It interacts with Claude directly through the standard Anthropic API (or LiteLLM/OpenAI-compatible endpoints) rather than running Claude Code or Anthropic's proprietary harness under the hood.
